Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1439); Gedeon (i.e. Gid(e)on), an Israelite:--Gedeon (in the King James Version).
BiblicalUsage: Gideon is a person named once in Scripture, in Hebrews. The full story lives on the Gideon profile, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gideon matters because God keeps names in His book for a reason, and I take that seriously. I hold that every name in Scripture is there on purpose, even the ones the Bible says little about.
RelatedEvents: Samson and Delilah; Gideon's Victory over Midian
